one_liner: Netlify has a broad, self-serve REST API with OAuth2 and personal access tokens, a free plan, and an official MCP server.
auth_notes: Public integrations must use OAuth2 (create an OAuth app in user settings). Personal access tokens can be generated in user settings for single-user use.
access_notes: The Free plan ($0, 300 credits) includes deploying via API. There is no separate API charge, but API usage consumes the same credit pool as the platform.
blocker_notes: None. Free credits are limited, but the API and OAuth are self-serve.
